response.rationale: CD56 and EBV positivity with CD20 negativity strongly favor extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type; plasmablastic lymphoma typically lacks CD56 and is less associated with EBV in this context.

rejected.why: CD56 positivity and EBV positivity are atypical for plasmablastic lymphoma, which usually shows CD138 but not CD56.
